summary: A responsive Xiaohongshu-style (RED) visual exploration homepage dedicated to trending portrait photography. It features a responsive masonry waterfall grid showcasing popular portrait posts with high-resolution imagery, creator profiles, engagement metrics (likes, favorites), search and filter capabilities by trending tags, interactive lightbox preview with detailed creator notes, and smooth infinite scroll loading.
core_features: Responsive Masonry Waterfall Layout (双列/多列响应式瀑布流展示人物照片卡片，卡片自适应高度与平滑加载)
Trending Portrait Card Component (包含高质量人物照片封面、标题、创作者头像与昵称、点赞数交互与高亮状态)
Interactive Detail Modal / Lightbox (点击照片卡片弹出全屏/半屏详情浮层，支持高清大图预览、详细笔记描述、标签及互动区)
Tag & Category Filter Bar (热门人物摄影标签导航栏，如'街拍穿搭'、'复古写真'、'情绪人像'、'艺人神颜'、'日系胶片'等快速筛选与高亮)
Search and Sort Mechanism (支持按关键词搜索人物或摄影师，并支持按'最热'、'最新'、'点赞最多'等维度排序)
Infinite Scroll & Mock Data Generation (基于虚拟滚动或触底无限加载模拟流行热度人物照片流，内置丰富高清人像摄影Mock数据)
Like & Favorite Interactive Feedback (卡片及详情弹窗支持点赞收藏，具有微动效并实时更新点赞计数与本地持久化)
non_functional_requirements: Performance: First Contentful Paint (FCP) < 1.0s, 保持 60fps 流畅滚动体验，对屏幕外图片采用原生 loading='lazy' 及骨架屏 (Skeleton) 占位
Visual & UX: 严格遵循小红书风格视觉规范（暖灰白背景、柔和圆角卡片、精致微边框、主题红 #ff2442 高亮与点赞动效）
Responsive Design: 移动端优先适配（手机屏幕 <768px 双列瀑布流，平板及桌面端 >=768px 自适应 3-5 列）
Robust Error Handling: 图片加载失败时自动展示优雅的默认人像占位图并保持卡片布局比例，避免累积布局偏移（CLS < 0.1）
Code Quality & Cleanliness: 模块化组件设计，状态管理清晰，易于单测与端到端自动化测试验证

user_stories.title: Browse Trending Portrait Waterfall Grid
user_stories.i_want: to view a dynamic waterfall (masonry) feed of trending portrait photos on the homepage
user_stories.so_that: I can effortlessly browse visually appealing high-popularity portrait photographs in a layout familiar to Xiaohongshu users
acceptance_criteria: Given the user visits the homepage, when the page loads, then high-resolution portrait cards are rendered in an unbalanced multi-column waterfall grid (2 columns on mobile, 3-4 columns on desktop).
Each card displays the portrait image cover, post title, author avatar, author nickname, and like count with an icon.
Images use progressive loading or skeleton shimmer placeholders before loading to avoid layout shifts.
Broken image links fallback gracefully to an elegant default portrait placeholder without breaking column flow.

user_stories.title: View Portrait Details and High-Res Preview
user_stories.i_want: to click any portrait card to open an interactive modal lightbox
user_stories.so_that: I can inspect the full-resolution photo, read the creator's caption/tags, and see engagement details
acceptance_criteria: Given a portrait card on the feed, when the user clicks or taps the card, then a modal pops up displaying the full-size image alongside post text, author info, publication date, and associated tags.
The modal can be closed via a close button ('X'), clicking the background backdrop, or pressing the Esc key on keyboard.
Scrolling the modal content locks the background body scroll to prevent disorientation.

user_stories.title: Filter Portraits by Trending Tags
user_stories.i_want: to filter portrait posts by trending photography tags (e.g., '街拍穿搭', '情绪人像', '复古写真', '日系胶片')
user_stories.so_that: I can quickly discover specific styles of trending person portraits that match my interests
acceptance_criteria: Given the top tag navigation bar, when the user clicks a specific category tag, then the waterfall feed filters instantaneously to show only cards matching that tag.
The active tag is visually highlighted with an active badge style (Xiaohongshu red pill style).
Clicking '全部' (All) or re-clicking the active tag clears the filter and restores all trending portraits.

user_stories.title: Like / Unlike Portrait Posts
user_stories.i_want: to click the like heart icon on any card or detail modal
user_stories.so_that: I can express appreciation for popular portrait creators and see the like counter update immediately
acceptance_criteria: Given an unliked portrait card, when the user clicks the heart icon, then the icon turns solid red with a subtle spring bounce animation and the like counter increments by 1.
When the user clicks the liked heart icon again, it reverts to the outline state and decrements by 1.
Like state is synchronized between the feed card and the detail modal.
Like states persist in browser localStorage across page reloads.

user_stories.title: Infinite Scroll Feed Continuation
user_stories.i_want: more trending portraits to load automatically as I scroll near the bottom of the feed
user_stories.so_that: I can continuously enjoy an uninterrupted discovery experience without manual pagination clicks
acceptance_criteria: Given the user scrolls within 300px of the page bottom, when scrolling stops or reaches threshold, then a loading indicator appears and the next batch of trending portrait cards is appended to the grid.
If no more items are available, a subtle footer message '已加载全部精彩内容' (All caught up) is displayed.
Throttling/debouncing is applied to scroll event listeners to prevent duplicate requests and maintain 60fps.

user_stories.title: Search and Sort Trending Portraits
user_stories.i_want: to search portraits by creator name or title keyword, and sort by '最热' (Hot) or '最新' (Latest)
user_stories.so_that: I can locate specific portraits and control the ranking order
acceptance_criteria: Given the search input in the header, when the user types a keyword, the cards filter in real-time or upon pressing Enter.
Given the sort switcher ('最热' / '最新'), clicking sorts the feed immediately by like count descending or publish time descending.
When a search yields 0 results, an empty state illustration with '未找到相关人像笔记' and a reset button is shown.
